newsitem.title: UK: Harvey Nash Group Plc to float at 175p on April 3.
newsitem.headline: Harvey Nash Group Plc to float at 175p on April 3.

text.p: IT recruitment services group Harvey Nash said on Wednesday it plans to float its shares on the London Stock Exchange on April 3 via a placing at 175p.
The placing, by broker Cazanove and underwritten by NatWest Markets, will raise 17.3 million stg, including 1.3 million stg of new money. It will value Harvey Nash at 48.8 million stg.
The group said the placing price represented a multiple of 19.2 times adjusted earnings per ordinary share for the year ended 31 January 1997.
Joint MD David Treacher said the float would assist in the group's expansion and strengthen its finances.
"The flotation of Harvey Nash is an important milestone for the group," he said in a statement.
"It will help us establish a presence in new markets, strengthen the group's balance sheet and ensure that Harvey Nash is well placed to maintain its record of strong profit growth," he said.
"In addition, it will give employees a greater opportunity to participate in the future success of the group," he said.
